newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Bank/Portugal seen cutting absorption rate - poll.
newsitem.headline: Bank/Portugal seen cutting absorption rate - poll.

text.p: The Bank of Portugal is expected to cut its absorption rate used to drain funds from the money market on Friday, seven out of nine economists contacted by Reuters said.
Most said they expected a cut of 20 basis points (bps) and one said he expected a cut of up to 50 bps.
Six of the nine analysts said they did not expect a cut in the repo rate and the other three said they expected a cut of between 10 and 30 bps.
The Bank of Portugal will announce money market conditions at 1415 GMT on Friday ahead of a new central bank accounting period.
All the analysts contacted by Reuters said they expected further official rate cuts this year.
The repo rate is presently 6.50 percent and the absorption rate is 6.20 percent.
The questions and answers were as follows:
1. Will the Bank of Portugal lower the repo rate this week?:
No - 6 replies
Yes - 3 replies
2. If the answer to question 1. is affirmative, by how much will the repo rate drop?
10 to 20 basis points - 2 replies
25 to 30 basis points - 1 reply
3. Will the Bank of Portugal cut its absorption rate this week?
No - 2 replies
Yes - 7 replies
4. If the answer to question 3. is affirmative, by how much will the absorption rate drop?
10 to 20 basis points - 5 replies
25 to 30 basis points - 1 reply
30 to 50 basis points - 1 reply
5. Is there room to cut official rates further?
No - 0 replies
Yes - 9 replies
-- Fernanda Pargana, Lisbon newsroom +351-1-3538254
